purpose: Resident bodies V3: cast the 24 people-v3 residents onto the natively imported PilgrimRigV3 variants. The staged directories are the Routes V2 documents (Scripts/release_resident_routes_v2.py) plus one body = {variant, visualScale} per person taken from the reviewed casting in Scripts/release_pilgrim_v3_review.spec.json residentSwap.casting (rendered in resident-swap-plan.json). Asset paths are read from the import marker review-native-progress.json (Interchange added a folder level named after the file and prefixed the clips with the mesh name), never assumed. The visual scale is a skeletal-mesh COMPONENT scale with the pivot at the feet (relative location stays (0,0,-96)); never the Character actor, its 34/96 capsule or the amah scale; never multiplied by 0.96. The imported meshes face UE +Y, so the mesh relative yaw is -90 (the V2 rig keeps +90). Native apply registers the cast variants on the population actor (hard references, so they cook) and stages the JSON; PIE verify reports what actually spawned. Casting is authored characterisation, not a sourced or halachic statement.

defaultBody.note: The V2 rig stays on the population as the fallback; it faces UE -Y so its relative yaw is +90. Paths per Scripts/release_people_v3.spec.json rig.

restCm.source: PilgrimRigV2 rig-definition.json and review-native receipts restPositionsUeCm (identical on every V3 variant)
